stem: Why is the fox's plan important to the resolution of the story?

options.label: F
options.text: The plan helps the crows learn how much they like their home.

options.label: G
options.text: The plan causes the snake to move away from the tree.

options.label: H
options.text: The plan gives the snake a chance to find an important necklace.

options.label: J
options.text: The plan proves to the crows that they like attention.
